highlights.title: A remote Claude sign-in stays on your screen
highlights.line: From a laptop or phone, a Claude sign-in opens no browser on the far computer, and Sign in again reopens its dialog after a Kosmos+ sign-in.

highlights.title: A restarted computer says it is still starting
highlights.line: After a restart, a protected action sent through Kosmos+ may say Kosmos+ is still starting: try again in a minute, not update Kosmos.

highlights.title: A room post that names you can reach your phone
highlights.line: When an agent's room post names you, by @-name or in its opening line, your phone can get the notice a reply to you gets.

highlights.title: A window Kosmos cannot confirm says so
highlights.line: A window Kosmos cannot confirm it started reads Not linked to Kosmos on the board, and a message to it says why it was not sent.

highlights.title: A refused download asks where to save
highlights.line: When macOS refuses a download into Downloads, the Mac app says why and where to allow Kosmos, and offers Choose Where to Save.
